name: Sunburnt
description: Generic sunburn state. Apply with [state <char> -> sunburnt]. Layers reddened, tender skin onto the character; overlays append to existing anatomy prose.

properties.affect_summary: Sunburnt — skin hot and tender across the exposed areas, flinching at contact, faintly miserable about it.
properties.mannerism_overlay: Winces when anything brushes the burn, holds clothing away from raw skin, hisses at sudden contact, moves stiffly.

body_overlays.chest: The skin across her chest is flushed an angry pink-red, hot and tender, tight enough that it stings when she moves.
body_overlays.arms: Her shoulders and arms are sunburnt red, the skin tender and warm to the touch.
body_overlays.legs: The tops of her legs are reddened and sun-tender.
